title: Reply to a message
summary: Lets the person reply to one message: a bar above the composer shows what they reply to, and the sent message shows a short quote of the original. A tap on the quote scrolls to the original.

eventId.description: Event ID of the original message.

state.description: loading: the SDK is fetching the original. ready: senderName and preview are set. unavailable: the original could not be loaded or was deleted.

senderName.description: Display name of the original sender, or bipe_app_you.

preview.description: One line of the original: its text, or the deleted or undecryptable text of timeline-rows.

replyingTo.description: The bar above the composer. Missing when the person is not replying.

rowId.description: The message to reply to. Must have canReply.

startReply.effect: Sets replyingTo, focuses the composer and keeps the draft text. Also runs from a swipe on the message.

cancelReply.effect: Clears replyingTo. The draft text stays.

sendReply.effect: chat-timeline send with replyingTo: sends the draft as a reply to the original, then clears draft and replyingTo.

openOriginal.effect: Scrolls to the original and highlights it for a moment. When it is not loaded, back-paginates until it is, at most 5 pages; then does nothing.

eventId.description: A quote in state loading or unavailable.

loadReply.effect: Asks the SDK for the original when a quote comes on screen without details.

notes: MsgLikeContent.inReplyTo gives the quote. EmbeddedEventDetails Unavailable and Pending map to loading until loadReply ran once; Error maps to unavailable.
The bar shows bipe_app_message_replying_to with the sender name, then the preview, and a close button labelled bipe_app_cancel.
Replies are plain replies. Threads are not in a DM (ADR 0141) and not in this spec for groups.
The preview is one line, cut with the system truncation. Media previews come with #561.
Swipe to reply: right on the message row, on both platforms. Screen readers use the message-actions action instead.
